text.content: Wrap-up
1 Quick pair review
Lesson A Find out!
What are two types of movies that both you and your partner like? You have two minutes.
A: | like action movies. Do you?
B: No, but | like animated movies. Do you?
Lesson B
Match the questions with the suggestions. You have one minute.
a We could take a walk.
1 Weshould see a movie. Do you have any suggestions? _._ We could take a walk.
a
b Whydon't we go to the market?
2 Vm hungry. Any suggestions? b Why don’t we go to the market?
3Let'sget some exercise.What do you suggest?
c Wecould seea comedy
d Why don't we go to Mexico?
4 Where should we go shopping? Any suggestions? d Why don’t we go to Mexico?
e Let's make pizza!
We need to take a vacation? What do you suggest? Let’s make pizza!
Lesson C Brainstorm!
Make a list of types of music. How many do you know? Take turns. You and your partner
have two minutes.
Guess!
Lesson D
Describe a popular band or singer, but don’t say the name. Can your partner guess
the name? Take turns. You and your partner have two minutes.
A: She sings pop music. She sings in Korean and Japanese. She's also an actress.
B: BoA?
A: Yes. Her real name is Kwon Bo-ah.
In the real world
What were some of the top movies this year? Go online and find information about one
of them in English. Then write about it.
@ What’s the name of the movie?
What actors are in it?
What type of movie is it?
What songs are in the movie?
"SSS SER SRPR EBB ee
A Top Movie
was one of the top movies this year.
